witness.branch: Outside-crosswalk crossing beginning with road entry
witness.quote: at any point other than within a marked crosswalk or within an unmarked crosswalk at an intersection
witness.reason: Road entry can begin a complete pedestrian crossing outside crosswalks.
required_context: Construct an entry route continuing across the roadway outside both crosswalk categories.
Establish an afoot entry continuing across the roadway, rather than merely occupancy at its edge.
Establish the distinct other vehicle's position, motion and relationship to the entry and crossing route.
Inventory all roadway vehicles and retain roadway, sidewalk and intersection geometry.
Inventory all roadway vehicles and retain their classifications, positions, directions, speeds and interactions throughout the crossing.
Preserve the unresolved Section 11.30.070 exception, municipal definition applicability and uninterpreted right-of-way standards.
Retain jurisdiction and unresolved Section 11.30.070 applicability.
Retain roadway and shoulder boundaries, sidewalks, intersections and both crosswalk categories.
witness.subject_reason: The pedestrian party enters and crosses on foot; no vehicular entry eligibility is assumed.
